narrative:
Operating expenses of about GBP 516M (13.6% of revenue) are planned by cost centre, account and legal entity: distribution, sales and broker; claims and customer operations; technology, data and digital; underwriting, actuarial and pricing; and finance, people and corporate.

Two thirds of OpEx is people cost driven from the workforce plan. The biggest non-people levers are outsourced contact-centre volumes, which fall as digital claims submission grows, and software licences, which fall as BU planning and reporting consolidate onto the same Snowflake platform as group planning.
